hero.title: {name}: the open source platform connecting models, knowledge and agents
hero.introFirst: LangChat is built for teams creating knowledge-augmented and agent-driven applications, bringing model access, knowledge engineering, agents, skills and MCP into one product system. It offers app configuration UIs plus a complete pipeline from data preparation and capability orchestration to streaming chat and platform governance.
hero.introSecond: The core value is consolidating scattered AI capabilities into manageable, composable, deliverable business modules — keeping teams technically autonomous while avoiding the cost of rebuilding model gateways, RAG pipelines, tool invocation and permission systems.

architecture.title: System Component Architecture
architecture.description: Module relationships from frontend interaction and service aggregation to core AI capabilities and infrastructure
architecture.diagramDesc: Users access LangChat Server through LangChat UI. The server aggregates permissions, AIGC, AI runtime and common services, connecting to relational databases, vector databases, S3 object storage, model providers and MCP services.

architecture.diagramNote: Module boundaries follow the current repository layout; data and external services can scale independently in deployment.
